CustomField.description: Determines how multiple assigned approvers must act before the step advances. Any: any one assigned approver can approve or reject. All: all assigned approvers must approve (unanimous) before the step advances — one rejection is still final.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set to All when multiple ApprovalStepApproverConfig__mdt records are configured for this step and unanimous approval is required. Rejection is always immediate regardless of this setting.
CustomField.label: Approval Mode
